l, Sagar Cantonment Board – 470001 Sagar Cantonment Board invites rates through e-tendering from reputed Manufacturers / companies / authorized suppliers / distributors in two bid syste m (technical and commercial bid) for supply of generic medicine and allied item s consumables from the Cantt General Hospital, Sagar Cantonment Board-4700 01. Tender No. Store/GeM Tender/Medicine/2026-27 Name of Work Rate contract for supply of Generic Medici nes and allied items to the Cantt General Hospital, Sagar Cantonment Board – 4700 01. Technical Bid: (Upload the following documents in technical bid) 1. Scanned copy of last three years Income tax returns. 2. GST Registration Certificate :Scanned copy of GST registration cer tificate to be submitted. 3. Affidavit on non-judicial stamp paper of Rs.500/- that we are not blacklisted any au thorities/ Departments. Also that the rates quoted in the tender are not higher tha n MRP. 4. Scanned copy of the partnership deed if the bidder is a partnership co ncern and the letter of authority from the individual who is authorized t o sign on behalf of the firm. 5. Scanned copy of the same nature work experience certificate / supply orders / work orders sho wn above supplied in various Govt. / Semi Govt. of two years. 6. Signed and scanned copy of PAN Card. 7. Bidder should submit EMD Rs. 50000.00 (Fifty Thousand Only) in form of scanned copy must be loaded with technical Bid. It is compulsory to deposit the EMD and tender form fee through E- C hhawani portal only. (If E- Chhawani portal is not working then EMD can be submitted to Cantt B oard Account. The details of account is as follows: Chief Executive Officer, Cantonment Board Sagar Bank Account Number 09532010019240 IFSC : PUNB0095310 Punjab National bank). 8. Duly attested scanned copies of Valid Drug licences held by the bidde r as on the date of bid opening in specified forms ( 20,20-B,21,21-B an d 21-C) for various categories of allopathic drugs issued by the Drug Co ntrol Authority of the State under the provision of Drug and Cosmetics Act, 1940. The successful bidder will ensure that their licenses remain valid till the end of the contract period. 9. The tenderer should be either Manufacture or Distributor / Stockiest / Wholesaler having relevant license of Manufacture or Distributor / Stoc kiest / Wholesaler and such registration should be valid as on the date

of tender submission. 10. Valid drug manufacturing license / Wholesaler License from FDA. 11. Distributor should submit Authorization letter from manufacturer (if an y). Chief Executive Officer of Cantonment Board Sagar whose decision will be fi nal and binding on the contractor. Financial /Price bid 1. Schedule of price bid in the form of BOQ_.xls Don’t tamper/ change the BOQ_ .xls sheet otherwise bid will be rejected. The Cantonment Board / Chief Executive Officer reserve t he right to accept or reject any or all tenders without assigning any reason. NO MANUAL BID WILL BE ACCEPTED. Chief Executive Officer Cantonment Board, Sagar ( ABHIJEET BHANAWAT IDES ) Ø Security Deposit: Successful tenderer will have to deposit 5% of the total Final cost of tender amount as security deposit and same will be released after completion of warranty period i.e. 01 years from the d ate of the agreement. Failure to complete the supply of all or any of the items within the stipulated period wi ll result in forfeiture of Security deposit. No interest shall be paid on the security deposit. It is compulsor y to deposit the EMD and tender form fee through E- Chhawani portal only. Ø (If E- Chhawani portal is not working then EMD can be submitted to Cantt Board Account. The details of accou nt is as follows: Chief Executive Officer, Cantonment Board Sagar Bank Account Number 09532010019240 IFSC: PUNB0095 310 Punjab National bank). GENERAL TERM AND CONDITIONS 1. 1. The life of medicine should be 80% from the date of supply of medicin e to the department. 2. L1 Seller need to supply a each medicines sample to this office a

s per specification provided in BOQ. Only after approval of sampl e, the Bid will be executed further. 3. Eligible contractors / agencies should submit their bid well in advance instea d of waiting till last date. Sagar Cantonment Board will not be responsible fo r non-submission of Bid due to any website related problems. 4. All the required documents for Technical Bid must be available with the tend erer/ agency. Failure to produce the required documents, disqualify the ten derer for bid. 5. The tender should be filled by responsible and authorized person in all respe ct. 6. The digital signature of tenderer should be made. 7. The tenderer shall be deemed to have full knowledge of E-tendering, all req uired documents site, conditions etc. Whether inspected or not by him. 8. The medicine / drug including its packing (packaging), to be supplied sha ll be of the best quality & WHO/GMP/ISO/CE certified and shall comply wit h the specifications given in the tender document. 9. The price quoted by the tenderer shall not in any case, exceed the contr ol price, if any, fixed by the central Government under D P C O and the M aximum Retail price (MRP). 10. The bidder shall take back drugs, which are not utilized by the tender inviting authority within the shelf life period based on mutual agreement. 11. Each and every batch of drug / medicines supplied by the suppliers shall be subjected to quality test by the laboratories selected / empaneled by t he tender inviting authority. 12. The samples ate collected from the stores from each batch of supply of t he same drug and after eliminating the common batch, samples shall be t aken in random, decoded and to be sent to the empanelled testing labora tories for testing the quality of drugs. 13. Delivery period : Within 15 days from the date of receipt of supply ord er to the firm. However the hospital may ask for supply within a week in case of emergency. These supplies shall be marked as "EMERGENCY SUP PLY". Payment shall not be made till full quantity has supplied. Items fo und damaged on receipt at Medical store shall be taken back and replace d within a month or sooner by vendor, on intimation, at no cost to the Boa rd. 14. Place of Delivery : Cantt General Hospital, Sagar Cantonment Board, Sag ar-470001. 15. PENALTY: Any delay in supply will be liable for levy of penalty @ 0.5% / d ay of the ordered value of items or minimum of Rs.2000/- per day, whichev er is more. Delay of more than 15 days beyond confirmed supply order sc hedule (1 month) shall result in cancellation of order. The items shall then be purchased from market and payment adjusted from the security deposit of L1 bidder / contractor. 16. The rates quoted by the tenderers are inclusive of GST , Service T ax, Income Tax, Cartage, Railway freight, octroi duties, Governmen t taxes and other charges whatsoever as and when applicable from

time to time to any Govt. department as per rules related to the co ntract. 17. The Accepting Officer has right to accept or reject any or all tenders without assign any reason. 18. The Contractor will make his own arrangement to provide manp ower for supply of the same. 19. On no account will any claim for compensation for loss sustained due to flu ctuation of price in the market during the tenure of the contract will be con sidered. 20. That in the event of any dispute arising the two parties, the matter shall be referred by the aggrieved party to the committee of arbitration as per secti on 325 to 330 of Cantonment Act, 2006 and the decision of such committe e will be binding on both the parties. 21. Institutional price and MRP of all items quoted will be mentioned as a ma ndatory requirement in all quotations. 22. The quantity of items and items may increase or decrease. 23. Successful tenderer shall have to execute a contract deed / contract agreement before award of contract / work. The terms and conditions laid down therein will be binding on the tenderer, whose tender will be ac cepted. The copy of the contract deed / agreement shall be available in the store branch of Sagar Cantonm ent Board Office and any tenderer can have a look at the same for their information before the submission of the tender. 24. In the case the tenderer fails to supply the items, the same will be procure by the Board through other age ncies at the risk and cost of the successful tenderer and any loss sustained by the Board will be recovered from the successful tenderer and he will be held responsible for all the consequences. And the security de posit shall be forfeited under such circumstances and the remaining amount of loss sustained by the Boar d can be recovered for the tenderer / agency / firm / bidder. 25. The office will issue firm a supply order as per the demand of the Cantt Hospital and it will mention the qu antity of medicines. You have to supply the medicines to the hospital as per the given time period. 26. The quantity of items may increased/decreased as per the requirement of the Board and as pe r the Budgetary provisions.
